official_sources.title: Robinhood Chain mainnet announcement
official_sources.fact: Public mainnet launched July 2026; chain positioned as AI-native and RWA-focused.

official_sources.title: Robinhood Chain docs
official_sources.fact: Permissionless EVM-compatible L2; supports account abstraction and RWA applications.

official_sources.title: Robinhood Chain connecting
official_sources.fact: Mainnet chain ID 4663; testnet 46630; Alchemy recommended for infrastructure.

official_sources.title: Robinhood Stock Tokens
official_sources.fact: Stock Tokens are ERC-20 tokenized debt securities providing economic exposure; they do not grant rights in the underlying securities.

official_sources.title: Robinhood Chain interest form
official_sources.fact: Official form accepts developer, infrastructure and marketplace interest.

official_sources.title: Robinhood Chain testnet launch
official_sources.fact: Robinhood committed $1M toward the 2026 Arbitrum Open House program.
